तालुन: तालुन तालुन, adj. formed fr. तलुन।
तालूर: तालूर तालूर, अस्, m. a whirlpool, an eddy; (also written तालुर; cf. तानूर।)
ताल्प: ताल्प ताल्प, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. तल्प), = तल्प्य, offspring of the marriage-bed.
तावक: तावक तावक (fr. तव), अस्, ई, अम्, thy, thine.
तावकीन: तावकीन, अस्, आ or ई (?), अम्, thine.
तावत्: तावत् तावत्, आन्, अती, अत् (fr. the pronom. base 2. त; correlative of यावत्), so great, so large, so much, so far, so long, so many, such (e. g. ता-वन्तस् तण्डुलाः, so many rice-grains; यावता क्षणेन तावता, after what time, in that time; यावन्ति तस्य द्वीपस्य वस्तूनि तावन्त्य् उपने-तव्यानि, whatever are the commodities of that island, so many are to be brought); तावता, ind. in the mean time, during that time; to that extent; तावत्, ind. so much, so greatly, to such an extent, in such a number, so far, so long, in that time (correlatively to यावत्, e. g. यावत् — तावत्, as long as — so long; when — then; यावत् त्रयस् ते जीवेयुस् तावन् नान्यं समाचरेत्, as long as those three live, so long he must perform no other duty), mean-while, in the mean time, (often connected with या-वत् and a negative, e. g. तावच् छोभते मूर्खो यावत् किञ्चिन् न भाषते, so long a fool shines as long as he says nothing; or with omission of the negative, e. g. शोषयिष्याम्य् आत्मानं तावद् यावन् मे प्राप्तम् ब्राह्मण्यम्, so long I will emaciate myself as long as, i. e. until I have obtained the state of a Brāhman); at once, now, just, (often connected rather redundantly with an imperative or with a potential or the verb अर्ह्, e. g. गच्छ तावत् or गच्छेस् तावत्, go now; तत् तावद् वाक्यं क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि, deign now to pardon that speech); indeed, really, truly, well, (as an emphatic particle, or to express assent, e. g. दृढस् तावद् बन्धः, the knot is tight I must admit; गता तावत्, she is indeed gone; sometimes connected in this sense with the particle एव, e. g. विक्रयस् तावद् एव सः, it is really a sale.) न तावत्, not at all; not yet (e. g. न तावद् दृश्यते सूर्यः, the sun is not yet visible); इतस् तावत्, away then! just come hither; मा तावत्, by no means, God forbid! यावत् — द्विस्-तावत्, as long — twice so long. According to the lexicographers तावत् may imply measure, limitation, totality, restriction, surprise, emphasis, &c.; [cf. Lat. tantus fr. tavantus; Gr. τόσος, τῆμος.] —तावच्-छत (°वत्-श°), अस्, ई, अम्, a measure containing so many hundreds. —तावच्-छस् (तावत्-शस्), ind., Ved. in so many ways, so manifoldly. —तावत्-कालम्, ind. for so long a period, for such a time. —तावत्-कृत्वस्, ind. so many times. —तावत्-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, having such results. —तावद्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, having so many qualities. —तावद्-द्वयस, अस्, ई, अम्, measuring so much, so long, &c. —तावद्-धा, ind. in that number, in such a number; so many times, so often. —तावद्-वर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, so many years old. —तावद्-व्यक्त, (in alg.) a known number annexed to an unknown quantity. —तावन्-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, just so much, just so many. —तावन्-मान, अस्, आ, अम्, measuring so much.

तावतिथ: तावतिथ, अस्, ई, अम्, the so manieth, such a one (of a number).
तावत्क: तावत्क, अस्, आ, अम्, bought for so much, worth so much, of so much value, &c.; [cf. तावतिक।]
तावर: तावर तावर, अम्, n. a bow-string.
ताविष: ताविष ताविष, अस्, ई, m. f. the ocean; heaven or paradise; gold; [cf. तविष।]
तावीष: तावीष, अस्, m. the ocean; heaven or paradise; gold; (ई), f. a river; the earth; N. of a daughter of Indra; N. of a daughter of the moon (?); [cf. तवीष।]
तावुरि: तावुरि तावुरि, इस्, m. (borrowed fr. the Gr. ταῦρος), the sign of the Zodiac Taurus.
तास्कर्य: तास्कर्य तास्कर्य, अम्, n. (fr. तस्कर), theft, robbery, larceny.
तास्यन्द्र: तास्यन्द्र तास्यन्द्र or तास्विन्द्र, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
ति: ति ति = इति in the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa.
तिक्: तिक् तिक्, cl. 1. A. तेकते, &c., to go or move [cf. rt. तीक्]; cl. 5. P. तिक्नोति, &c., to go or move; to assail, assault; to wound; to seek to injure or kill; to challenge; [cf. rt. तिग् and स्तिघ्।]

तिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, bitter (as sharpening the appe-tite), pungent; fragrant; (अस्), m. a bitter taste; one of the six modifications of flavour (रस); bit-terness, pungency; fragrance, perfume; N. of several plants, viz. Wrightia Antidysenterica (= कुटज); Capparis Trifoliata (= वरुण); Agathotes Chirayta (= किरात-तिक्त); Melia Azadirachta; Terminalia Catappa (= इङ्गुदी); a bitter sort of cucumber, Trichosanthes Cucumerina (?); a kind of salt; (आ), f., N. of several plants, viz. Curcuma Zedoaria. —तिक्त-गन्धा or तिक्त-गन्धिका, f. mustard, Lycopodium Imbricatum. —तिक्त-गुञ्जा, f. Pongamia Glabra, = करञ्ज. —तिक्त-घृत, अम्, n. a mixture of Ghṛta with bitter herbs &c. —तिक्त-तण्डुला, f. long pepper. —तिक्त-तुण्डी, f. = कटु-तुण्डी. —तिक्त-तुम्बी, f. = कटु-तुम्बी, a bitter gourd. —तिक्त-दुग्धा, f., N. of several plants, = क्षीरिणी, अज-शृङ्गी, स्वर्ण-क्षीरी. —तिक्त-धातु, उस्, m. bile. —तिक्त-पत्त्र, अस्, m. a cu-curbitaceous plant, Momordica Mixta. —तिक्त-पर्-वन्, आ, f., N. of several plants, viz. Strychnos Potatorum [cf. कतक]; (आ), f., N. of several plants, = यव-तिक्ता, वार्ताकी, षड्-भुजा. —तिक्त-भद्रक, अस्, m. a kind of cucumber, Trichosanthes Dioica. —तिक्त-मरिच, अस्, m. Strychnos Potatorum; [cf. कतक।] —तिक्त-यवा, f., N. of a plant, = शङ्-खिनी. —तिक्त-रोहिणिका or तिक्त-रोहिणी, f. a medi-cinal plant, = कटु-रोहिणी. —तिक्त-वल्ली, f. the plant Sanseviera Roxburghiana. —तिक्त-वीजा, f. a kind of cucumber, = कटु-तुम्बी. —तिक्त-शाक, अस्, m. ‘bitter herbs or greens,’ N. of several plants, viz. Menispermum Glabrum. —तिक्तायन (°त-अय्°), अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. possessing the heat or radiance of fire.

तिरस्य: तिरस्य, nom. P. तिरस्यति, &c., to disappear.
तिरोहय: तिरोहय, nom. P. तिरोहयति, -यितुम्, to hide, conceal.
तिरस्कर: तिरस्कर तिरस्-कर, तिरस्-कृ, &c. See under तिरस्, col. 2.
तिरिजिह्विक: तिरिजिह्विक तिरिजिह्विक, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), Erythrina Crista Galli (?).
तिरिटि: तिरिटि तिरिटि, इस्, or तिरिट, अस् (?), m. the joint of the sugar-cane.
तिरिन्दिर: तिरिन्दिर तिरिन्दिर, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
तिरिम: तिरिम तिरिम or तिरिय, अस्, m. a sort of rice; [cf. तिर्य।]
तिरीट: तिरीट तिरीट, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. तॄ, perhaps for तिरी-त्र, or a wrong form for किरीट), a kind of head-dress, a tiara, a diadem; gold; (अस्), m. the tree Symplocos Racemosa.
तिरीटक: तिरीटक, अस्, m. a kind of bird.
तिरीटिन्: तिरीटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. furnished with a head-dress.
तिरो: तिरो तिरो for तिरस्। See under तिरस्।
तिर्पिलि: तिर्पिलि तिर्पिलि, इस्, m., N. of an author.
तिर्य: तिर्य तिर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = तिल्य, Ved. prepared from the seeds of sesamum (?); [cf. तिरिय।]
तिर्यग: तिर्यग तिर्यग for तिर्यग्-ग। See तिर्यञ्च्।
तिर्यञ्च्: तिर्यञ्च् तिर्यञ्च् or तिर्यच्, अङ्, तिरश्ची, or according to Vopa-deva also तिर्यञ्ची, अक् (fr. तिरस् and rt. अञ्च्), going or lying crosswise or transversely or obliquely, oblique, transverse (opposed to अन्व्-अञ्च्), horizontal (opposed to ऊर्ध्व, vertical); going across; crossing over, traversing; moving tortuously, going crookedly or awry; curved, crooked; mean-dering; lying in the middle or between; (अङ्, अक्), m. n. an animal (going horizontally, as opposed to man who walks erect), a brute, an amphibious animal; a bird; (with Jainas) plants, the organic world; (तिरश्ची or तिर्यञ्ची), f. the female of an animal or of any beast or bird; (अक्), ind., Ved. across, obliquely, transversely, horizontally, sideways; तिरश्चा, ind. across, obliquely. —तिरश्चि-राजि, इस्, इस्, इ (तिरश्चि loc. case of तिर्यञ्च्), Ved. striped across (as a ser-pent). —तिर्यक्-कारम् or तिर्यक्-कृत्य, ind. having laid aside (after the completion of any work), having placed on one side. —तिर्यक्-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, placed obliquely or across; a form of dislocation when a part of the joint is forced outwards. —तिर्-यक्-ता, f. or तिर्यक्-त्व, अम्, n. the state of going across or obliquely; the state of a beast or animal, animal nature; measurement across, breadth. —तिर्-यक्-पातन, अम्, n., N. of a part of the Ānanda-kanda, treating of medicine. —तिर्यक्-प्रमाण, अम्, n. measurement across, breadth; पुरस्तात्-तिर्यक्प्रमाण, breadth in front; पश्चात्-त्°, breadth behind. —तिर्यक्-प्रेक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking obliquely or askance; (अम्), n. a squint, oblique glance, side look. —तिर्यक्-प्रेक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, looking obliquely or sideways. —तिर्यक्-सूत्र, अम्, n. a cross-line. —तिर्यक्-स्रोतस्, अस्, n. ‘the hori-zontal stream of life,’ the animal creation; (आस्), m. ‘hurrying the stream of life horizontal,’ i. e. the animal world; an animal, a beast or bird; [cf. अर्वाक्-स्रोतस्, अवाक्-स्रोतस्, ऊर्ध्व-स्रोतस्।] —तिर्-यग्-अन्तर, अम्, n. intermediate space measured across, breadth. —तिर्यग्-अयन, अम्, n. the hori-zontal course, the annual revolution of the sun, (opposed to its diurnal revolution, in which it rises and sets vertically.) —तिर्यग्-आगत, अस्, आ, अम्, lying across (a particular position of the child at birth). —तिर्यग्-ईक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, looking obliquely; [cf. तिर्यक्-प्रेक्षण।] —तिर्यग्-ईश, अस्, m. ‘the lord of the animals,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —तिर्यग्-ग (or sometimes तिर्य-ग), अस्, आ, अम्, going obliquely, going across or horizontally [cf. प्रतीप-ग, अधो-मुख, ऊर्ध्व-ग]; an animal; going towards the north or south, (opposed to पूर्व-मुखी and पश्चान्-मुखी।) —तिर्यग्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, going horizontally, (opposed to man who walks erect.) —तिर्यग्-गति, इस्, f. the course of an animal, trans-migration of animals. —तिर्यग्-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, going sideways or obliquely. —तिर्यग्-गमन, अम्, n. motion sideways or across, (opposed to ऊर्ध्व-ग्° and अधो-ग्°।) —तिर्यग्-गुणन, अम्, n. oblique multiplication. —तिर्यग्-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born from an animal, having an animal as father or mother. —तिर्यग्-जन, अस्, m. an animal. —तिर्यग्-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, belonging to the race of animals or to the brute creation, born as an animal; (इस्), f. the brute kind. —तिर्यग्-ज्या, f. an oblique chord. —तिर्यग्-दिश्, क्, f. the region or part of the universe which lies horizontally, (opposed to ऊर्ध्व and अधस्।) —तिर्यग्-धार, अस्, आ, अम्, having curved or oblique edges. —तिर्यग्-नास or तिर्यङ्-नास, अस्, आ, अम्, crooked-nosed, wry-nosed. —तिर्यग्-यवोदर (°व-उद्°), अम्, n. a barleycorn. —तिर्यग्-यान, अस्, m. ‘going crookedly,’ a crab. —तिर्यग्-योन, अस्, m. an animal (as a bird &c.); [cf. तैर्यग्योन।] —तिर्यग्-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, born of or as an animal; (इस्), f. the womb of an animal, the animal creation or race, organic nature (including plants). —तिर्यग्योन्य्-अन्वय, अस्, आ, अम्, of the animal race; (अस्), m. the race of animals, birds, &c. —तिर्यग्-विद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, pierced obliquely (as a vein in bleeding by an unskilful operator). —तिर्यङ्-निरय, अस्, m. the hell of animals or animal nature as a punishment for evil deeds.
तिरश्च: तिरश्च, अम्, n., Ved. the cross-board of a bed-stead. —तिरश्चाङ्गिरस (°च-आङ्°), अस्, m. the Āṅgirasa Tiraśca; [cf. तिरश्ची।]
तिरश्चता: तिरश्चता, ind., Ved. across, transversely, through.
तिरश्ची: तिरश्ची, m., Ved., N. of a Ṛṣi, descendant of Aṅgiras. —तिरश्ची-निधन, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
तिरश्चीन: तिरश्चीन, अस्, आ, अम्, lying across, oblique, trans-verse, sideways, awry, horizontal; irregular; आ-तिर-श्चीनम्, a little across. —तिरश्चीन-निधन, अम्, n., Ved., N. of a Sāman. —तिरश्चीन-पृश्नि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. spotted across. —तिरश्चीन-वंश, अस्, m., Ved. a bee-hive.
तिल्: तिल् 1. तिल्, cl. 1. P. तेलति, &c., to go or move; [cf. rt. तिल्ल्।]
तिल् 2. तिल् (probably an artificial rt. fr. तिल below), cl. 6. 10. P. तिलति, तेलयति, &c., to be unctuous or greasy; to oil or anoint.
तिल: तिल, अस्, m. the sesamum plant (Sesamum Indi-cum) which bears an oily seed; the seed of this plant (much used in Oriental cookery); a mole or spot compared to a seed of sesamum; a small particle or portion as much as a sesamum-seed [cf. कृष्ण-तिल and चर्म-तिल]; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a chapter of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva. —तिल-कट, अम्, n. the farina of sesamum. —तिल-कल्क, अस्, m. dough made of ground sesamum. —तिलकल्क-ज, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), oil-cake made of the sediment of ground sesamum. —तिल-कालक, अस्, m. a mole, a dark spot under the skin; a disease of the penis in which the fleshy parts become black and die off; (अस्, आ, अम्), having a mole or mark. —तिल-किट्ट, अम्, n. the caky sediment of sesamum after the oil is pressed out. —तिल-खलि, इस् or ई f. oil-cake made from sesa-mum. —तिल-गञ्जि-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place mentioned in the Rasika-ramaṇa by Raghu-nātha. —तिल-ग्राम, अस्, m., N. of a Grāma or township. —तिल-चित्र-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. a kind of bulbous plant. —तिल-चूर्ण, अम्, n. sesamum ground and pounded. —तिल-तण्डुलक, अम्, n. an embrace (as agreeable as rice mixed with sesamum). —तिल-तेजा, f. a kind of plant. —तिल-तैल, अम्, n. sesa-mum-oil. —तिलदेश्वर-तीर्थ (°द-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha; [cf. तिलकेश्वर-तीर्थ।] —तिल-द्वादशी, f. a festival occurring on the twelfth day of a particular month. —तिल-धेनु, उस्, f. sesamum made up in the shape of a cow for the purpose of being presented to Brāhmans &c. —तिलधेनु-दान, अम्, n., N. of a chapter of the Vārāha-Purāṇa. —तिलन्-तुद, अस्, आ, अम्, bruising sesamum-seed, a sesamum-grinder, one who extracts oil out of sesamum-seed; [cf. तिल-पीड।] —तिल-पर्ण, अस्, m. turpentine; (ई), f. the sandal tree, Pterocarpus Santa-linus; frankincense; turpentine; (अम्), n. the leaf of the Tila tree; sandal-wood. —तिल-पर्णिका, f. or तिल-पर्णिक or तिल-पर्णक, अम्, n. red sanders, sandal-wood. —तिल-पिच्चट, अम्, n. (पिच्चट = पिष्टक), a sort of sweetmeat made chiefly of ground sesamum. —तिल-पिञ्ज, अस्, m. barren sesamum, bearing no blossom or yielding a seed which gives no oil; white sesamum; [cf. तिल-पेज, तिल्पिञ्ज, तैल-पिञ्ज।] —तिल-पीड, अस्, m. = तिलन्-तुद; [cf. तैल-पीड।] —तिल-पुष्पक, Terminalia Bellerica (वि-भीतक). —तिल-पेज, अस्, m. barren sesamum; [cf. तिल-पिञ्ज।] —तिल-भार, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race. —तिल-भाविनी, f. jasmine. —तिल-भृष्ट, अम्, n. fried sesamum-seed. —तिल-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of or prepared from sesamum, abounding with sesamum. —तिल-मयूर, अस्, m. a species of pea-cock. —तिल-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed with sesamum. —तिल-रस, अस्, m. sesamum-oil. —तिल-वत्स, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having sesamum-seed (as it were) for children. —तिल-व्रतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, eating only sesa-mum-seeds in consequence of a vow. —तिल-शस्, ind. in pieces as small as sesamum-seeds. —तिल-सम्-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed with sesamum-oil. —तिल-स्नेह, अस्, m. oil, especially of sesamum. —तिल-होम, अम्, n. burnt-offering of sesamum. —तिलाङ्-कित-दल (°ल-अङ्°), अस्, m. a kind of bulbous plant, = तैल-कन्द. —तिलाढक? (°ल-आढ्°), N. of a monastery; (also read तिलटक, तिलढाक, तिल-शाक्य।) — तिलान्न (°ल-अन्°), अम्, n. rice with sesamum-seeds. —तिलापत्या (°ल-अप्°), f. a plant bearing a small pungent seed, Nigella Indica. —तिलाम्बु (°ल-अम्°), उ, n. water with sesamum. —तिलोत्तमा (°ल-उत्°), f., N. of an Apsaras; a form of Dākṣāyaṇī; N. of a woman. —तिलोदक (°ल-उद्°), अम्, n. sesamum-seeds and water (as an oblation). —तिलौदन (°ल-ओद्°), अम्, n. a dish of milk, rice, and sesamum.
तिलक: तिलक, अस्, m. a species of tree with beautiful flowers, (so called either because it is similar in some way to the sesamum plant, or because it is used as an ornament like the mark on the forehead); a plant growing near water; a freckle, a natural mark under the skin (compared to a seed of sesamum); a kind of eruption of the skin; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a mark or marks made with coloured earths, sandal-wood, or unguents, upon the forehead and between the eyebrows, either as an ornament or a sectarial distinction; the ornament of anything (used in comp. to express greatness or distinction, e. g. त्रैलोक्य-तिलक, the ornament of the three worlds, i. e. a distinguished personage); (अस्), m. the burden of a song, = ध्रुवक; a species of horse; N. of a son of Pra-dyota; N. of a prince of Kampanā; (आ), f. a kind of necklace; (अम्), n. the bladder; the lungs; black sochal salt, a factitious salt containing sulphur and iron &c.; a disease, the appearance of dark spots on the skin, unattended with inflammation; alliteration; a kind of metre consisting of four lines of six syllables each; [cf. ऊर्ध्व-तिलकिन्, एण-तिलक, ख-त्°, वसन्त-त्°।] —तिलक-राज, अस्, m., N. of a man. —तिलक-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a chapter of the second part of the Bhaviṣya-Purāṇa, treating of ceremonies. —तिलक-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a man. —तिलका-श्रय (°क-आश्°), अस्, m. the forehead (‘the receptacle of the Tilaka’). —तिलकेश्वर-तीर्थ (°क-ईश्), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha; [cf. तिलदेश्वर-तीर्थ।]
तिलकक: तिलकक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
तिलकाय: तिलकाय, nom. A. तिलकायते, &c., to form the Tilaka mark on the forehead, to ornament.
तिलकित: तिलकित, अस्, आ, अम्, marked with the Tilaka, or-namented; freckled, spotted.
तिलकिन्: तिलकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, marked with the Tilaka; freckled, spotted.
तिलु: तिलु, an adj. derived by Sāy. fr. तिल, and meaning ‘fertile,’ ‘rich;’ [cf. तिल्विल below.]
तिल्पिञ्ज: तिल्पिञ्ज, अस्, m., Ved. = तिल-पिञ्ज, q. v.
तिल्य: तिल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, suited for the cultivation of sesamum, grown with sesamum; (अम्), n. a field of sesamum.
तिल्व: तिल्व or तिल्वक, अस्, m. the tree Symplocus Racemosa, = इङ्गुदी, Terminalia Catappa.
तिल्विल: तिल्विल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a fertile soil, prolific, rich; [cf. इभ्य-तिल्विल and धान्य-त्°।]
तिल्विलाय: तिल्विलाय, nom. A. तिल्विलायते, &c., Ved. to be fertile or rich, to cause fertility of soil.
तिलकनिज: तिलकनिज तिलकनिज, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race.
तिलिङ्ग: तिलिङ्ग तिलिङ्ग, N. of a place mentioned in the Kāka-rudra-saṃvāda.
तिलिङ्गिल: तिलिङ्गिल तिलिङ्गिल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (also तिमिङ्गिल, तिलेङ्गल।)
तिलित्स: तिलित्स तिलित्स or तिलिच्छ, अस्, m. a large snake; (according to some = Gokhura; according to others = the Boa or Boa Constrictor.)
तिल्ल्: तिल्ल् तिल्ल्, cl. 1. P. तिल्लति, &c., to go or move; (a various reading for 1. तिल्।)
तिव्य: तिव्य तिव्य, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman.
तिष्ठत्: तिष्ठत् तिष्ठत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (pres. part. fr. rt. स्था), staying, remaining, abiding, standing, being, &c. —तिष्ठद्-गु, ind. (गु fr. गो), at milking-time (when the cows stand to be milked), after sunset. —तिष्ठद्-धोम (°अत्-हो°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (a sacrifice) at which the oblation is offered standing, (opposed to उपविष्ट-होम।)
तिष्य: तिष्य तिष्य, अस्, m., N. of a mythical being who like Kṛśānu is a kind of heavenly archer; an asterism regarded as shaped like an arrow and containing three stars, of which δ Cancri is one, (it is the sixth Nakṣatra of the old or eighth of the new order, and is also called Puṣya and Sidhya); the month Pauṣa (December-January); a common N. of men, ‘born under the asterism Tishya’ [cf. उप-तिष्य]; (आ), f. Terminalia To-mentosa; Emblica Officinalis; Emblic Myrobalan; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the Kali-yuga, the fourth or present age; (अस्, आ, अम्), auspicious, fortunate, lucky (?). —तिष्य-केतु, उस्, m. an epithet of Śiva. —तिष्य-पुनर्वसीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the asterisms Tiṣya and Punar-vasu. —तिष्य-पुष्पा, f. Emblic Myrobalan (आमलकी). —तिष्य-फला, f. Emblic Myrobalan. —तिष्य-रक्षिता, f., N. of the first wife of Aśoka.
तिष्यक: तिष्यक, अस्, m. the month Pauṣa.
तिसृ: तिसृ तिसृ, तिस्रस्, f. pl. three; see त्रि, —तिसृ-धन्व, अम्, n., Ved. a bow with three arrows.
तिसृका: तिसृका, f., N. of a Grāma.

तु 3. तु, ind. (a particle, perhaps connected with the pronom. base 2. त, or with the Vedic pro-noun त्व; never found at the beginning of a sentence or verse, and causing the verb with which it is con-structed to retain its accent). As a particle implying ‘earnest entreaty’ or ‘urgent request’ it is often used in the Veda, like Lat. dum, with an imperative, and may be translated by ‘pray!’ ‘I beg,’ ‘do’ (e. g. आ त्वेत, come here, do); or it may be rendered by ‘well,’ ‘now then,’ ‘now,’ ‘just.’ As an adversative particle it is equivalent to ‘but,’ ‘on the contrary,’ ‘on the other hand’ (e. g. न च्छिनति जनयति तु, he does not destroy but he produces). The sense ‘but’ is most common in later Sanskrit.

तु is sometimes, however, used for च, ‘and’ (e. g. आ समुद्रात् पूर्वाद् आ समुद्रात् तु पश्चि-मात्, to the eastern sea and to the western sea); and even for वा, ‘or’ (e. g. उष्ट्र-यानं समारुह्य खर-यानं तु, having ascended a camel-carriage or one drawn by donkeys). Sometimes it appears to be incorrectly written for नु (e. g. किन् तु for किन् नु). Occasionally it seems to be used for तदा after चेत् (e. g. तां चेद् न दित्सेयम् प्रमथ्यैनां हरेयुस् तु, if I were not willing to give her then they would take her by force). Not unfrequently तु is used as an expletive to fill out a verse or prevent the blending of vowels (e. g. ईर्ष्यी घृणी त्व् अ-सन्तुष्टः, &c., an envious man, one over-com-passionate, a discontented man, &c.). तु — तु, although — yet; अपि-तु, moreover; किन् तु, but, nevertheless, notwithstanding; परन् तु, more-over, but, nevertheless; न त्व् एव तु, but by no means. According to lexicographers तु implies dis-junction, mutual opposition, alternative, asseveration, emphasis, conjunction, &c.

तुम्बर: तुम्बर तुम्बर, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a kind of plant; (ई), f. = तुवरी, a sort of earth, = तुबरी, a bitch.
तुम्बरु: तुम्बरु तुम्बरु, उस्, m., N. of a Gandharva; (perhaps a wrong reading for तुम्बुरु।)
तुम्बुम: तुम्बुम तुम्बुम, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race or people; [cf. तुम्बुर।]
तुम्बुर: तुम्बुर तुम्बुर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race; (ई), f. coriander; a bitch; [cf. तुम्बरी।]
तुम्बुरु: तुम्बुरु तुम्बुरु, उस्, m., N. of a pupil of Kalāpin; N. of a Gandharva; N. of the attendant of the fifth Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; (उ), n. the fruit of Diospyros Embryopteris; coriander; (according to others उस्, उ), m. n. the plant and seed of Diospyros Embryopteris.
तुम्र: तुम्र तुम्र, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. तुमुर above], Ved. big, strong, powerful; wild; (Sāy.) energetic (= प्रेरक); destroying or defeating adversaries; see तूतुम; [cf. Lat. tumidus.]
तुर्: तुर् 1. तुर् (connected with rts. तॄ, त्वर्, and तूर्), cl. 6. P. A., Ved. तुरति, -ते, &c., to hurry, hasten, press forwards, run; overcome; in-jure; cl. 3. P., Ved. तुतोर्ति: Caus. तुरयति, -यितुम्, to run: Desid., Ved. तूतूर्षति: Intens. A., Ved. in the part. तर्तुराण, running forwards; [cf. rt. त्वर्; Gr. τύρ-βη, τύρ-βα, τυρβάζω, τυρβασία, Τυρ-μ-ίδαι; Lat. turba, turbare, turb-idu-s, turma; Angl. Sax. thrym, ‘multitude, mass, troop;’ Goth. thaurp; Old Germ. dorf, ‘conference, assembly, meeting;’ Old Island. thyrpaz, ‘to congregate.’]
2. तुर्, तूर्, तूर्, तूर्, Ved. running a race, hasten-ing, fighting, conquering, a warrior; [cf. अप्-तुर्, आजि-तुर्, &c.]
तुर: 1. तुर, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. 3. तुर see p. 379, col. 1), Ved. furthering, promoting, a promoter; quick, will-ing, prompt; (अम्), ind. quickly. —तुर-ग, अस्, m. ‘going quickly,’ a horse; the mind, thought; (ई), f. a mare, = अश्व-गन्धा, the plant Physalis Flexuosa; [cf. तुरङ्-ग and तुरङ्-गम।] —तुरग-गन्धा, f. = तुर-गी, Physalis Flexuosa; [cf. तुरङ्ग-गन्धा।] —तुरग-दानव or तुरग-दैत्य, अस्, m. ‘horse-titan’ or ‘Dānava in the shape of a horse,’ an epithet of Keśin. —तुरग-नील-ताल, अस्, m. a kind of gesture with the hand. —तुरग-प्रिय, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), barley, ‘liked by horses;’ [cf. तुरङ्ग-प्रिय।] —तुरग-ब्रह्म-चर्यक, अम्, n. the sexual restraint of horses, i. e. compulsory celibacy, leading a life of continence, in consequence merely of being without female society. —तुरग-मेध, अस्, m. a horse-sacrifice, = अश्व-मेध. —तुरग-रक्ष, अस्, m. ‘horse-guardian,’ a groom, an equery. —तुरग-लीलक, अस्, m. a particular time in music. —तुरग-वदन or तुरगानन (°ग-आन्°), आस्, m. pl. ‘horse-faced,’ N. of a race in the north of Madhya-deśa. —तुर-गातु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. going quickly. —तुरगारोह (°ग-आर्°), अस्, m. ‘one mounted on a horse,’ a horseman. —तुरगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, equestrian, riding, mounted or carried on a horse; (ई), m. a horseman, a cavalier. —तुरगीय, an adj. derived fr. तुर-ग in खर-तुरगीय-सम्-पर्क, अस्, m. sexual intercourse between asses and horses. —तुरगोपचारक (°ग-उप्°), अस्, m. ‘attending to horses,’ a groom, an equery. —तुरङ्-ग, अस्, m. ‘going quickly,’ a horse; a N. of the number seven (because of the seven horses of the sun); the mind considered as the seat of feeling as well as of intellect, the heart; (ई), f. a mare, = तुर-गी, Physalis Flexuosa, = घोटिका, Cucumis Uti-lissimus; [cf. तुर-ग and तुरङ्-गम।] —तुरङ्-गक, अस्, m. the plant Luffa Fœtida; (इका), f. a kind of cucurbitaceous plant, = देव-दाली, the large dark-green pumpkin. —तुरङ्ग-गन्धा, f. = तु-रग-गन्धा. —तुरङ्ग-द्विषणी, f. (for -द्वे-षणि), a she-buffalo. —तुरङ्ग-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of the chief of a sect. —तुरङ्ग-प्रिय, अस्, m. = तुरग-प्रिय, barley. —तुरङ्-गम, अस्, m. a horse; (ई), f. a mare; [cf. तुर-ग and तुरङ्-ग।] —तुरङ्गम-शाला, f. a horse-stable. —तुरङ्ग-मेध, अस्, m. a horse-sacrifice, = अश्व-मेध। —तुरङ्ग-यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going on horseback. —तुरङ्ग-वक्त्र or तुरङ्ग-वदन, अस्, m. ‘horse-faced,’ a Kinnara or chorister of Indra's heaven. —तुरङ्ग-सादिन्, ई, m. a horseman, a horse-soldier. —तुरङ्ग-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. a troop of horses. —तुरङ्ग-स्थान, अम्, n. a horse-stable. —तु-रङ्गारि (°ग-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of the horse,’ a buffalo; fragrant oleander (करवीर). —तुरङ्गा-रूढ (°ग-आर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, mounted on horseback; (अस्), m. a horseman. —तुरङ्गिन्, ई, m. a horse-man, a rider, a groom; [cf. तुरगिन्।] —तुर-या, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. going quickly.

तुर 2. तुर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. तु; for 1. तुर see p. 378, col. 3), Ved. strong, powerful, excelling, surpassing, overpowering; an epithet of Indra, of the Maruts, Ādityas, &c.; possessed of property; rich; abundant, abounding; (अस्), m., N. of a preceptor and priest with the patronymic Kāvaṣeya. —तुरा-षाह्, -षाट्, ट्, ट्, overpowering the mighty or over-powering quickly, epithet of Indra and of Viṣṇu; (ट्), m. a N. of Indra.
तुर 3. तुर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hurt, wounded; (according to Sāy. = आ-तुर, q. v.)
तुरण: तुरण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. quick, swift, energetic; (अम्), n. haste.
तुरण्य: तुरण्य, nom. P., Ved. तुरण्यति, &c., to be quick or swift; to make haste, to accelerate.
तुरण्यसद्: तुरण्य-सद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. dwelling among the quick or active.
तुरण्यु: तुरण्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. quick, swift, energetic, zealous.
तुरस्पेय: तुरस्-पेय, अम्, n., Ved. anything drunk quickly (?).
तुरी: 1. तुरी, f., Ved. overpowering strength, superior power. (For 2. तुरी see col. 2.)

तुरी 2. तुरी, f. (or तुरि, इस्, in the first sense; cf. तुलि), the fibrous stick used by weavers to clean and separate the threads of the woof; a painter's brush; a shuttle; N. of a wife of Kṛṣṇa (or Vasu-deva) and mother of Jaras. (For 1. तुरी see col. 1.)
तुर्या: तुर्या, f., Ved. overpowering or superior strength.
तुरायण: तुरायण, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. 2. तुर), N. of a man; (अम्), n., N. of a particular sacrifice or vow, = पौर्णमास-विकार, a modification of the full moon sacrifice; N. of a Sattra; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. attachment to any object or pursuit; attached to any object or pursuit (?); [cf. परायण।]
तुरकिन्: तुरकिन् तुरकिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Turkish; [cf. तुरुष्क।]
तुरक्व: तुरक्व तुरक्व, N. of a people, ‘the Turks;’ [cf. तुरुष्क।]
तुरग: तुरग तुर-ग, तुरङ्ग। See 1. तुर, p. 378.
तुरष्क: तुरष्क तुरष्क, N. of a country and people mentioned in the Śrī-ṣavāyaṇa or part of the Ro-maka-siddhānta.
तुरीप: तुरीप तुरीप, अम्, n., Ved. seminal fluid; (अस्), m. an epithet of Tvaṣṭṛ, ‘spermatic.’
तुरीय: तुरीय 1. तुरीय, P., Ved. तुरीयति, &c., to go or move; [cf. rt. 1. तुर् and तुरण्य।]

तुरीय 2. तुरीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fourth, a fourth; consisting of four parts; whose power ex-tends on all four sides, mighty; (अम्), n. the fourth state of the soul (according to the Vedānta phil.), that state in which it has become one with Brahma or the universal spirit; (अस्, आ, अम्), (with a different accent), a fourth, constituting the fourth part; (अम्), n. a fourth part, a quarter; [cf. तुर्य and चतुर्थ।] —तुरीय-भाग, अस्, m. a fourth part or share. —तुरीय-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, a sharer of a fourth —तुरीय-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the fourth caste; (अस्), m. the fourth caste or tribe, a Śūdra. —तुरीयांश (°य-अं°), अस्, m. a fourth part or share, a quarter. —तुरीयातीत (°य-अत्°), N. of an Upaniṣad. —तुरीयार्ध (°य-अर्°), अम्, n. one half of a fourth, an eighth part.
तुरीयक: तुरीयक, अस्, आ, अम्, a fourth (part).
तुर्य: तुर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = 2. तुरीय, fourth, a fourth; (अम्), n. the fourth state of the soul, in which it be-comes one with Brahma, a quarter; (अस्, आ, अम्), being in the above state; the fourth (part). —तुर्य-वह् or -वाह्, ट्, f. तुर्यौही, Ved. an ox or cow four years old.
तुर्य तुर्य। See above under 2. तुरीय।
तुरुष्क: तुरुष्क तुरुष्क, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race, the Indo-Scythian race or Turks; (अस्), m. the country of this race, Turan or Turkestan; a prince of this race; (अस्, अम्), m. n. olibanum, Indian incense, the resin of the Boswellia Serrata; the resin of the Pinus Longifolia; [cf. यावन।]
तुर्फरि: तुर्फरि तुर्फरि, Ved. (fr. rt. तृफ्), accord-ing to Yāska = क्षिप्र-हन्तृ, striking quickly; (ac-cording to Sāy., तुर्फरी, du. = killers of the enemy.)
तुर्फरीतु: तुर्फरीतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. according to Yāska = हन्तृ, striking; (according to Sāy., तुर्फरीतू, du. = तर्फितारौ = शत्रूणां हन्तारौ।)
तुर्व्: तुर्व् तुर्व् [cf. rt. 1. तुर्], cl. 1. P., Ved. तूर्-वति, तुतूर्व, तूर्वितुम्, to overpower, overcome, excel; to cause to overpower or conquer, help to victory; to save; to strike, to hurt, kill, injure; [cf. तूर्वयाण and तूर्वि।]
तुर्वणि: तुर्वणि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 1. तुर्), Ved. overpowering, excelling, victorious; (Sāy.) acting quickly, serving quickly, moving quickly; injuring or destroying enemies.
तुर्वन्: तुर्वन्, अ, n., Ved. (only used in the dat. तुर्-वणे), conquering, defeating, injuring.
तुर्वश: तुर्वश तुर्वश, अस्, m. (also written तुर्वसु), Ved., N. of a hero and ancestor of the Āryan race, often mentioned in the Ṛg-veda and probably re-lated to the Kaṇvas; he is generally mentioned together with his brother Yadu; N. of a whole race; [cf. तुर्वसु and तौर्वश।]
तुर्वसु: तुर्वसु तुर्वसु, उस्, m. (a later form of तुर्वश), N. of a son of Yayāti and Devayāni and brother of Yadu.
तुर्वीति: तुर्वीति तुर्वीति, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a man or of a race.
तुल्: तुल् तुल् [cf. rt. तूल्], cl. 10. P. A. (accord-ing to Vopa-deva also cl. 1. P.) तोलयति or तुलयति, -ते, (the form तोलयति is rarely used in the metaphorical sense), तोलति, अतूतुलत्, -यितुम्, to lift up, raise; to determine the weight of anything by lifting it; to weigh, poise, measure; to compare by weighing and examining; to ponder, weigh in the mind, consider; to examine with distrust, suspect; to make equal in weight, to equal, compare one thing with another (with inst., e. g. न ब्राह्मणैस् तुलये भूतम् अन्यत्, I do not compare any other being with Brāhmans); to counterpoise, counter-balance, outweigh, weigh against, equal in weight, match, be equal to (with acc.); to possess in the same degree, to attain, reach; [cf. rt. दुल्: Old Lat. tul-o, te-tul-i: Lat. tul-i, lātus; (for tlātus), tollere, toll-o, tolleno, tolerare, tolūtim: Gr. τλῆ-ναι, τάλα-ς, πολύ-τλᾱ-ς, ταλα-ό-ς, τλή-μων, τάλ-αντο-ν, ἀ-τά-λαντο-ς, τάλ-αρο-ς, τελα-μών, τόλ-μα, τολμά-ω, Τάν-ταλο-ς: Goth. thul-an, ‘to tolerate;’ us-thul-ain-s, ‘patience:’ Angl. Sax. tholian, thyl-dian, athylgian: Old Germ. dol-an: Germ. duld-en: Slav. tul-ŭ, ‘a quiver.’]
तुलन: तुलन, अम्, n. lifting, raising; weighing, mea-suring; rating, assessing, taxing; a particular high number.
तुलयित्वा: तुलयित्वा, ind. having weighed, having counter-poised, having made equal or like, &c.
तुला: तुला, f. a balance, especially a fine balance, the beam of a balance, goldsmith's or assay scales; a measure, a weight, (तुलया धृ, to hold in a balance, to weigh); the balance as an ordeal; weigh-ing; resemblance, likeness, equality, similarity; the sign of the zodiac Libra; the seventh sign in a circle divided like a zodiac; a measure or weight of gold and silver = 100 Palas or about 145 ounces troy; a kind of vessel; sloping beams or timbers in the roof of a house; [cf. भार-तुला and तुलोपतुला।] —तुला-कोटि, इस्, ई, m. f. an ornament on the feet or toes of women; a particular weight; a hundred millions, = अर्बुद. —तुला-कोश or तुला-कोष, अस्, m. a place where a balance or pair of scales is kept; ordeal by weighing; see तुला-परीक्षा. —तुलाकोश-र-हस्य, अम्, n. a mystical rite which consists in weighing seeds and thence calculating the fertility of the soil. —तुला-दान, अम्, n. the gift to a Brāhman of as much gold, silver, &c., as equals the weight of the body. —तुला-धट, अस्, m. the scale or cup of a balance; an oar, a paddle. —तुला-धर, अस्, m. ‘holding a pair of scales,’ the sign of the zodiac Libra, the sun. —तुला-धार, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘holding a pair of scales;’ trading, trafficking, a trader, a dealer; (अस्), m. the string of a balance; the beam; the sign of the zodiac Libra; N. of a merchant. —तुला-पद्धति, N. of a book by Ka-malākara-bhaṭṭa. —तुला-परीक्षा, f. ordeal by the balance, (the weight of the accused being first taken, certain prayers and ceremonies are performed, after which he is weighed again; if lighter, he is innocent; if heavier, or as at first, guilty.) —तुला-पुरुष, अस्, m. ‘a weighed man,’ or gold, jewels, and other ornaments equal to a man's weight, an offering of such extent constituting one of the sixteen pious gifts; a kind of penance. —तुलापुरुष-दान, अम्, n. gift of gold or valuables to an amount equivalent to the weight of the donor. —तुला-प्रग्रह or तुला-प्रग्राह, अस्, m. the string of a balance. —तुला-मान, अम्, n. measure by weight. —तुला-यष्टि, इस्, m. or f. (?), the beam of a balance. —तुला-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with or possessed of a balance. —तुला-वीज, अम्, n. the Guñjā or berry of the Abrus Precatorius, from which the goldsmith's or jeweller's weight in India is taken; the berry weighs about 1(5/16) grain troy, the factitious weight about 2(3/16). —तुला-सूत्र, अम्, n. the string of a balance. —तुलोपतुला (°ला-उप्°), f. a supporting beam or prop in the roof of a house (?).
तुलित: तुलित, अस्, आ, अम्, made equal or like, equalled, compared (with inst., e. g. शशाङ्केन तुलित, com-pared with the moon); weighed, counterpoised.
तुल्य: तुल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, equal to, of the same kind or class, well matched, similar, comparable, equally valuable or precious, like, resembling (with gen. or inst., e. g. तुल्य एतस्य, equal to him; प्राणैस् तुल्या, a woman as dear as life; or with the crude form in comp., e. g. अमृत-तुल्य, similar to the immor-tals or to nectar; एतत्-तुल्य, equal to this man); fit for (with inst.); even, same; indifferent; (अम्), ind. equally, similarly, in like manner; (अस्), m., N. of a Gandharva. —तुल्य-ता, f. or तुल्य-त्व, अम्, n. equality, likeness, sameness, resemblance (with inst., e. g. वयसा तुल्यता, equality in age); equality of place, conjunction (in astronomy); दृक्-तुल्यता, conformity with any observed place. —तुल्य-तेजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, equal in splendor. —तुल्य-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्, regarding with equal or indifferent eyes. —तुल्य-पान, अम्, n. drinking together, compota-tion. —तुल्य-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, of equal strength. —तु-ल्य-भावना, f. (in arithm. or algebra) combination of like or analogous sets of magnitude. —तुल्य-मूल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of equal value. —तुल्य-योगिता, f. ‘com-bination of equal actions or qualities,’ a figure in rhetoric. —तुल्य-रूप, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, of like or equal form; like, similar, analogous. —तुल्य-लक्-षणा, f. a particular figure in rhetoric. —तुल्य-वंश, अस्, आ, अम्, equal in race, of equal race. —तु-ल्य-विक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, of equal prowess. —तुल्य-वीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of equal strength. —तुल्य-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, following the same or similar occupation. —तुल्य-शस्, ind. in equal parts. —तुल्य-शुद्धि, इस्, f. equal subtraction, transposition (in arithmetic). —तुल्य-शोधन, अम्, n. reducing an equation by removing the like magnitudes on both sides. —तु-ल्याकृति (°य-आक्°), इस्, इस्, इ, of the same form, alike. —तुल्यातुल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, similar and dis-similar, like and unlike. —तुल्यानुमान (°य-अन्°), अम्, n. like inference, a parallel case. —तुल्योद्योग (°य-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, equal in labours or exertions.
तुलकुचि: तुलकुचि तुलकुचि, इस्, m., N. of a prince.
तुलभ: तुलभ तुलभ, आस्, m. pl., N. of a warrior-tribe.
तुलभीय: तुलभीय, अस्, m. a prince of the above tribe.
तुलसारिणी: तुलसारिणी तुलसारिणी, f. = तूण, a quiver.

त्यक्तुकाम: त्यक्तु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to leave.
त्यक्तृ: त्यक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, resigning, leaving, abandon-ing, giving up, sacrificing; an abandoner, forsaker.
त्यक्त्वा: त्यक्त्वा, ind. having left, abandoned, surrendered, &c.; leaving aside, disregarding, with exception of.
त्यजन: त्यजन, अम्, n. leaving, quitting, abandoning; giving; excepting, exclusion.
त्यजनीय: त्यजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be left or abandoned, to be avoided, to be excepted, &c.
त्यजस्: त्यजस्, अस्, n., Ved. abandonment; difficulty, danger; alienation, estrangement, dislike, anger, aversion, envy; (Sāy.) a weapon or instrument causing abandonment; (आस्, आस्, अस्), m. f. n., Ved. offspring, a descendant.
त्याग: त्याग, अस्, m. leaving, letting go, abandoning, forsaking, parting from, deserting, renouncing, separa-tion; discharging; dismissing; giving up, resigning; gift, donation, distribution; sacrificing one's life; liberality, generosity, prodigality; secretion, excretion; a sage, one who separates himself from the world; [cf. आत्म-त्°, तनु-त्°, देह-त्°।] —त्याग-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a bill of divorcement. —त्याग-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting only in giving or in donation. —त्याग-युत, अस्, आ, अम्, liberal. —त्याग-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, disposed to give away, generous, liberal. —त्यागशील-ता, f. or त्यागशील-त्व, अम्, n. generosity.
त्यागिन्: त्यागिन्, ई, इनी, इ, leaving, abandoning, renouncing; giving up, resigning; sacrificing; liberal; (ई), m. an abandoner, (often applied to the religious ascetic who abandons terrestrial objects, thoughts, &c.); a giver, a donor; a hero. —त्यागि-ता, f. or त्यागि-त्व, अम्, n. liberality, generosity.
त्यागिम: त्यागिम, अस्, आ, अम्, left, abandoned.
त्याजक: त्याजक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who leaves, abandons, expels; leaving, abandoning, &c.
त्याजित: त्याजित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to quit or abandon; caused to be disregarded.
त्याज्य: त्याज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be left or abandoned or quitted, to be avoided or shunned, to be expelled, to be removed; to be given up or relinquished or abstained from; to be sacrificed; to be excepted; (अम्), n. part of an asterism or its duration con-sidered as unlucky.
त्यद्: त्यद् त्यद्, स्यस्, स्या, त्यद् (a pronoun com-posed of the base of the demonstrative pron. त and the relative य, and not found in the later language), Ved. that, that person or thing, (often used like the article in other languages, e. g. त्यद् वसु पणीनां विदस्, thou didst find that wealth, i. e. the wealth of the Paṇis); it is sometimes strengthened by चिद् and often occurs in connection with other demonstratives; (त्यद्), ind., Ved. indeed, namely, as it is known, (always preceded by the particle ह, e. g. त्वम् ह त्यद् इन्द्र कुत्सम् आवस्, thou indeed, O Indra, didst help Kutsa); [cf. Old Germ. dër fr. diar, f. diu, acc. dia = त्याम्, nom. pl. m. die = त्ये, f. dio = त्यास्, n. diu = त्यानि: to syā belongs Old Germ. siu, acc. sia: Lith. and Slav. szis, sy, = syas; szi, si, = syā.]
त्यत्र: त्यत्र, ind., Ved. at that place, there.
त्यत्रत्य: त्यत्रत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. existing or being there.
त्यद: त्यद, अस्, m. a son of that person; (अम्), ind. (at the end of an adv. comp.) = त्यद्।
त्यदायनि: त्यदायनि, इस्, m. a son of that person.
त्यादृश्: त्या-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, and त्या-दृश, अस्, ई, अम्, such a one as that.
त्र: त्र 1. त्र, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. त्रै), protecting (in comp.; see अंस-त्°, अङ्गुलि-त्°, आतप-त्°, कटि-त्°, &c.).
त्र 2. त्र = त्रि, three, in द्वि-त्र, q. v.
त्रंस्: त्रंस् त्रंस्, cl. 1. 10. P. त्रंसति, त्रंस-यति, &c., to speak or shine.
त्रख्: त्रख् त्रख्, cl. 1. P. त्रखति, &c., to go, move.
त्रङ्क्: त्रङ्क् त्रङ्क्, cl. 1. A. त्रङ्कते, &c., to go, move.
त्रङ्ख्: त्रङ्ख् त्रङ्ख् or त्रङ्ग्, cl. 1. P. त्रङ्खति or त्रङ्गति, &c., to go or move, (a various reading for त्वङ्ग्); [cf. Hib. tairgim, ‘I escape;’ tairgeadh, ‘going, passing.’]
त्रङ्ग: त्रङ्ग त्रङ्ग, अस्, आ, m. f. a kind of town or N. of a town; the city of Hari-ścandra supposed to be suspended in the air; [cf. द्रङ्क, द्रङ्ग, &c.]
त्रद: त्रद त्रद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. तृद्), Ved. split-ting, one who cleaves or opens; a creator; (Sāy.) = तर्दयितृ, a killer or injurer (of enemies).
त्रन्द्: त्रन्द् त्रन्द्, cl. 1. P. त्रन्दति, &c., to act, perform functions; to endeavour, strive; to be busy.
त्रप्: त्रप् त्रप्, cl. 1. A. त्रपते, त्रेपे, त्र-पिष्यते and त्रप्स्यते, अत्रपिष्ट and अत्रप्त, त्रपितुम् and त्रप्तुम्, to become per-plexed or embarrassed, to be ashamed, be modest: Caus. त्रपयति and त्रापयति, -यितुम्, to make perplexed or ashamed: Desid. तित्रपिषते and ति-त्रप्सते: Intens. तात्रप्यते, तात्रप्ति; [cf. Gr. τρέπω, έν-τρέπω; Lat. turpis, probably also trepi-dus, = Ved. तृप्र, ‘hastening;’ Lith. trópiyu, ‘to throw;’ Slav. trepet, ‘trembling;’ probably Goth. dreiban; Angl. Sax. drif-an, dref-an.]
त्रप: त्रप, अस्, आ, m. f. (more commonly आ, f.), per-plexity, embarrassment, bashfulness, shame, modesty; (आ), f. an unchaste woman (a shame to her family); family, race; fame, celebrity; [cf. Gr. ἐν-τροπή.] —त्रपा-निरस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, shameless, impudent. —त्रपान्वित (°पा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, modest, bash-ful, ashamed. —त्रपा-भर, अस्, आ, अम्, overcome with shame. —त्रपा-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, bashful, modest. —त्रपा-रण्डा, f. a harlot. —त्रपा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, modest, ashamed. —त्रपा-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, shameless, immodest, impudent.
त्रपमाण: त्रपमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being ashamed.
त्रपित: त्रपित, अस्, आ, अम्, modest, bashful, ashamed.
त्रपु: त्रपु, उ, n. tin; lead; (tin is said to be called त्रपु from its contracting just before melting; cf. लज्जालु, as a N. of the sensitive plant.) —त्रपु-कर्कटी, f. a kind of cucumber, = त्रपुसी. —त्रपु-कर्णिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having tin ear-ornaments; (ई), m. an epithet of Bhava-nandin.
त्रपुष: त्रपुष, अस्, m., N. of a merchant; a cucumber or melon; (ई), f. = त्रपुसी; (अम्), n. cucumber, the fruit of the Trapuṣī; tin.
त्रपुस्: त्रपुस् त्रपुस्। See under rt. त्रप् above.
त्रपुस: त्रपुस, अम्, n. cucumber, the fruit of the Trapusī; tin; (ई), f. coloquintida and other sorts of cucumber, = महेन्द्र-वारुणी, कर्कटी, पीत-पुष्पा।
त्रपाक: त्रपाक त्रपाक, अस्, m., N. of a barbarous tribe.
त्रपिष्ठ: त्रपिष्ठ त्रपिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of तृ-प्र), highly satisfied, much pleased or contented.
त्रपीयस्: त्रपीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of तृप्र), more satisfied, highly pleased.
त्रपुटी: त्रपुटी त्रपुटी, f. small cardamoms; [cf. also त्रि-पुटा and त्रि-पुटी।]
त्रप्र: त्रप्र त्रप्र, अम्, n. (a various reading for वप्र), lead.
त्रप्स्य: त्रप्स्य त्रप्स्य, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. तृप्), thin or diluted curds; (according to some authorities written द्रप्स्य and द्रप्स।)
त्रय: त्रय त्रय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. त्रि), triple, three-fold, consisting of three, divided into three parts, of three kinds, treble; (ई), f., scil. विद्या, the threefold knowledge, the triple science (i. e. sacred revelation in its threefold form of hymn, sacrificial formula, and song, afterwards represented by the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas), the three Vedas collectively (omitting the Atharvan, which is not of equal au-thority); a triad, three collectively, a triplet, three, (e. g. शत-त्रयी, 300); a matron, a married woman whose husband and children are living; intellect, understanding; N. of a plant (Conyza Serratula), = सोम-राजिन्; (अम्), n. a triad, three collectively, three, τριάς. —त्रयी-तनु, उस्, m. an epithet of the Sun (having the three Vedas for a body, either as celebrated in the Vedas or because the Sāma-veda and portions of the other Vedas are said to have proceeded from the Sun); an epithet of Śiva. —त्रयी-धर्म, अस्, m. the duty enjoined by the Vedas (i. e. the forms of sacrifice &c. prescribed by them). —त्रयी-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of the three Vedas, containing them, resting on them, &c. —त्रयी-मुख, अस्, m. a Brāhman (‘having the three Vedas in his mouth’). —त्रयी-विद, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. knowing the triple science; [cf. त्रयी and त्रैविद।]
त्रयस्: त्रयस्, nom. pl. of त्रि, three, (used in comp. with a following decad, except असीति which takes त्रि। The other decads, except ten, twenty, and thirty, may also take त्रि for + 3.) —त्रयः-पञ्चाशत्, त्, f. fifty-three; [cf. त्रि-पञ्चाशत्।] —त्रयः-षष्टि, इस्, f. sixty-three; [cf. त्रि-षष्टि।] —त्रयः-सप्तति, इस्, f. seventy-three; [cf. त्रि-सप्तति।] —त्रयश्-चत्वा-रिंश, अस्, ई, अम्, the forty-third. —त्रयश्-चत्वा-रिंशत्, त्, f. forty-three; [cf. त्रि-चत्वारिंशत्।] —त्रयस्-त्रिंश, अस्, ई, अम्, the thirty-third; joined with thirty-three (e. g. त्रयस्त्रिंशं शतम्, 133); consisting of thirty-three; celebrated with the Stoma which consists of thirty-three parts or syllables, con-taining that Stoma, &c. —त्रयस्-त्रिंशत्, त्, f. thirty-three. —त्रयस्-त्रिंशति, इस्, f., Ved. thirty-three. —त्रयस्त्रिंश-पति, इस्, m. the chief of the thirty-three gods, an epithet of Indra. —त्रयस्त्रिंश-स्तोम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. containing the Trayastriṃśa-stoma. —त्रयस्-त्रिंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, containing thirty-three. —त्रयो-दश, अस्, ई, अम्, the thirteenth; joined with thirteen or having thirteen added (e. g. त्र-योदशं शतम्, 113); consisting of thirteen; (ई), f. the thirteenth day of the lunar fortnight; a kind of gesticulation mentioned in the Purāṇa-sarva-sva. —त्रयोदशक, consisting of thirteen; (अम्), n. the number thirteen. —त्रयोदश-धा, ind. into or in thirteen parts. —त्रयो-दशन्, अ, m. f. n. pl. thirteen; [Gr. τρις-καί-δεκα for τρεῖς-° cf. Lat. tredecim for tres-decem; Lith. trylika fr. trydika.] —त्रयो-दशम, अस्, ई, अम्, the thirteenth. —त्रयोदश-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of thirteen kinds. —त्रयो-दशिक, happening on the thirteenth day of the half-moon. —त्रयो-दशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. containing thirteen. —त्रयो-नवति, इस्, f. ninety-three; [cf. त्रि-नवति।] —त्रयोविंश, अस्, ई, अम्, the twenty-third; consisting of twenty-three. —त्रयो-विंशति, इस्, f. twenty-three. —त्रयो-विंशतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of twenty-three. —त्रयोविंशति-तम, अस्, ई, अम्, the twenty-third. —त्रयोविंशति-धा, ind. in twenty-three parts, in twenty-three ways, &c.
त्रययाय्य: त्रययाय्य त्रययाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (ac-cording to Sāy.) = त्रातव्य, to be protected.
त्रय्यारुण: त्रय्यारुण त्रय्यारुण, अस्, m., N. of a prince, a son of Tri-dhanvan; a son of Uru-kṣaya; N. of the Vyāsa in the fifteenth Dvāpara.
त्रवाडिलघु: त्रवाडिलघु त्रवाडि-लघु, उस्, m., N. of the father of Mahī-dhara.
त्रस्: त्रस् 1. त्रस्, cl. 10. P. त्रासयति, -यितुम्, to take, seize; to hold; to oppose, pre-vent, forbid.

त्रस् 2. त्रस्, cl. 1. and 4. P. (ep. also A.) त्रसति, त्रस्यति, तत्रास (3rd pl. त-त्रसुस् and त्रेसुस्), त्रसिष्यति, अत्रासीत् and अत्र-सीत्, त्रसितुम्, to tremble, quiver, quake, or start with fear; to be agitated, be afraid of; to fear, dread (with abl. or gen. and more rarely with inst., e. g. तस्मात् or तस्य त्रस्यति, he fears that or is afraid of him); to run away, run: Caus. त्रासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to tremble, terrify, to frighten, scare, agitate, set in motion: Desid. तित्रसिषति: Intens. तात्रस्यते, तात्रस्ति; [cf. Zend tareś, tars-ti: Gr. τρέω for τρεσιyω, ταρταρίζω, τρήπων for τρεσ-πων, τρέ-μ, τάρβος, ταράσσω, θάλασσα, ὀ-τρηρός, ὀ-τραλέος: Lat. tristis = trasta; tremo; terreo fr. terseo for treseo = Caus. त्रासयामि: Goth. thlahs-yan: Russ. tryasu, ‘to shake;’ tryasu-sy, ‘I tremble:’ Lett. trīsseht, ‘to tremble:’ Hib. tor, ‘fear, dread.’]
त्रस: त्रस, अस्, आ, अम्, movable, moving, locomotive; (अम्), n. the collective body of moving or living beings; animals; animals and men, (opposed to स्थावर, cf. जगत्; under त्रस are sometimes reckoned gods, men, and the inhabitants of the lower regions); (अस्), m. the heart (‘the quivering one’); (अम्), n. a forest, a wood. —त्रस-दस्यु, उस्, m. ‘before whom evil beings tremble,’ N. of a prince, (celebrated for his liberality and favoured by the gods; he bears the patronymic Paurukutsya or Pauru-kutsi or Paurukutsa, and is supposed to be the author of certain Ṛg-veda hymns; in the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa त्रसद्-दस्यु, which is probably the original form, is identified with Māṃ-dhātṛ and regarded as the father of Puru-kutsa; the meaning of the name may be ‘frightening evil beings;’ cf. जमद्-अग्नि, तरद्-द्वेषस्, भरद्-वाज, &c.) —त्रस-रेणु, उस्, m. f. an atom, the mote or atom of dust which is seen moving in a sun-beam, especially considered as an ideal weight either of the lowest denomination or equal to three or (according to some) thirty invisible atoms; (उस्), f., N. of one of the wives of the Sun.
त्रसन: त्रसन, अम्, n. in हस्ति-त्रसनानि, the moving ornaments of an elephant (?).
त्रसर: त्रसर, अस्, m. a shuttle; weaving; = तसर।
त्रसुर: त्रसुर, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, timid, fearful.
त्रस्त: त्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, frighted, alarmed; timid, trembling, fearful; quick. —त्रस्त-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, terrified, fearful.
त्रस्नु: त्रस्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, fearful, timid, timorous.
त्रस्यत्: त्रस्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fearing, apprehending.
त्रास: त्रास, अस्, आ, अम्, moving, movable, locomotive; frightening; (अस्), m. fear, terror, anxiety; terrifying, frightening, causing alarm, (often in comp., e. g. त्रासार्थम्, ind. in order to frighten); a flaw or defect in a jewel. —त्रास-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing fear, fearful, alarming. —त्रास-दायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, causing alarm, fear-exciting.
त्रासदस्यव: त्रासदस्यव, अस्, m. a patronymic from Tra-sad-dasyu; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
त्रासन: त्रासन, अस्, ई, अम्, terrifying, alarming, frighten-ing (with gen.), making anxious; (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva; (अम्), n. the act of frightening or alarming; a means of frightening, cause of alarm, fright.
त्रासनीय: त्रासनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be dreaded, frightened, &c.
त्रासित: त्रासित, अस्, आ, अम्, frightened, scared, alarmed.
त्रासिन्: त्रासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fearful, timid, afraid.
त्रा: त्रा 1. त्रा (by native authorities written त्रै, q. v.), cl. 1. A. त्रायते, &c., to pro-tect, &c. See rt. त्रै, p. 394.
2. त्रा, आस्, m., Ved. a protector, a defender; [cf. 1. त्र।]
त्राण: त्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, preserved, saved, guarded, pro-tected; (अम्), n. protecting, preserving; protection, a preservative, defence; shelter, help, (often in comp., e. g. आर्त-त्राणाय, for the protection of the distressed; आत्म-त्राण, self-defence); protection for the body, armour; (आ), f., N. of a plant, = त्राय-माणा; [cf. Hib. troiath, ‘a helmet.’] —त्राण-कर्तृ, ता, or त्राण-कारिन्, ई, m. a preserver, pro-tector, saviour, deliverer.
त्राण, त्रात, &c. For these and other deriva-tives of the rt. त्रै see 1. त्रा, p. 388, col. 1.
त्रात: त्रात, अस्, आ, अम्, preserved, rescued, guarded, protected; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (अम्), n. pre-serving, protection.
त्रातव्य: त्रातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be guarded or protected.
त्रातृ: त्रातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a protector, saviour, guardian, defender; protecting, defending.
त्रात्वा: त्रात्वा, ind. having preserved or rescued.
त्रामन्: त्रामन्, अ, n., Ved. protection; [cf. सु-त्रामन्।]
त्रायत्: त्रायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, preserving, defending, pro-tecting; (अन्ती), f. a protectress; a medicinal plant; [cf. त्रायमाणा।]
त्रायमाण: त्रायमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, preserving, defending, a preserver; (आ), f., N. of a medicinal plant; also त्रायमाणिका, f.; [cf. कृत-त्रा।]
त्राहि: त्राहि (2nd sing. impv. of rt. त्रै), save! deliver! to the rescue!
त्रापुष: त्रापुष त्रापुष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. त्रपु), made of tin [cf. जातुष]; silver (produced from tin).
त्रापुस: त्रापुस त्रापुस, अस्, ई, अम्, sprung or coming from the plant Trapusī.
त्रायोदश: त्रायोदश त्रायोदश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. त्रयो-दशी), relating &c. to the thirteenth day of a half-moon.
त्रि: त्रि त्रि, त्रयस् m. pl., तिस्रस् f. pl., त्रीणि n. pl. (said to be fr. rt. तॄ; in Ved. त्री occurs for त्रीणि and त्रीणाम् for त्रयाणाम्), three; [cf. Gr. τρεῖς, τρί-α, τρί-το-ς, τρί-ς, τρισσό-ς: Zend thri, thri-tya, thris: Lat. tres, tri-a, ter-tiu-s, ter: Goth. threis, thriya, thri-dya: Angl. Sax. threo, thry, thri: Slav. triye, tre-tii, ‘third:’ Lith. trýs, ‘three;’ tré-cza-s, ‘third:’ to tisras belong Old Hib. teora, Cambro-Brit. f. tair, Armor. teir.] —त्रि-ककुद्, त्, त्, त्, having three peaks or points or horns &c.; (त्), m., N. of a mountain in the Himālaya [cf. त्रि-कूट and सु-वेल]; an epithet of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu; N. of a son of Śuci and father of Dharma-sārathi; a kind of ritual observance; the highest, chief. —त्रि-ककुद, अस्, आ, अम्, having three peaks or humps &c. —त्रि-ककुभ्, प्, प्, प्, Ved. having three peaks or points; an epithet of Indra's thunderbolt or of Indra himself; (प्), m., N. of a mountain; a kind of ritual observance; [cf. त्रि-ककुद्।] —त्रि-कट, अस्, m., N. of a plant (Ruellia Longifolia), = गो-क्षुरक; [cf. त्रि-कण्ट।] —त्रि-कटु, उ, n. or त्रि-कटुक, अम्, n. the aggregate of three spices, viz. black and long pepper and dry ginger; [cf. कटु-त्रय।] —त्रि-कण्ट, अम्, n. the three thorny plants, a collective N. of three kinds of Solanum, viz. बृहती, अग्नि-दमनी, and दुः-स्पर्शा; (अस्, आ, अम्), having three thorns; (अस्), m., N. of a plant, = गो-क्षुरक or पत्त्र-गुप्त; a kind of fish. —त्रि-कण्टक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = गो-क्षुरक; a kind of poisonous insect; a kind of fish (Silurus); a kind of weapon. —त्रि-कद्रुक, आस्, m. pl., Ved. probably a N. of three peculiar Soma-vessels [cf. कद्रु], or perhaps a N. of an oblation consisting of three offerings of the Soma (which is of a dark-brown colour); the first three days of the Abhi-plava festival which lasts six days, (respectively called Jyotis, Go, and Āyus.) —त्रिकद्रुकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, containing the word त्रि-कद्रुक. —त्रि-कर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, having three ears. —त्रि-कर्मन्, (at the beginning of a comp.) the three chief duties of a Brāhman, viz. sacrifice, study of the Vedas, and liberality (e. g. त्रि-कर्म-कृत्, performing these three duties); (आ, आ, अ), engaging in these three actions. —त्रि-कर्ष, अम्, n. = त्रि-कार्षिक. —त्रि-कला, f., N. of a female deity produced by the union of three gods for the destruction of Andhaka. —त्रि-काण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, consisting of three parts or divisions; forty-eight cubits long; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?), a work consisting of three parts, especially the dictionary of Amara-siṃha, also called Amara-koṣa. —त्रिकाण्ड-चिन्ता-मणि, इस्, m. or त्रिकाण्ड-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of commentaries on this work. —त्रिकाण्ड-मन्-दन, N. of a work. —त्रिकाण्ड-शेष, अस्, m. a vocabulary in three chapters supplementary to the Amara-koṣa by Puruṣottama. —त्रि-काय, अस्, आ, अम्, having three bodies; (अस्), m., N. of Buddha or of a Buddha. —त्रि-कार्षिक, अम्, n. the three contracting (कार्षिक fr. rt. कृष्) substances, dry ginger, Ati-viṣā, and Mustā; [cf. त्रि-कर्ष, दन्त-कर्षण।] —त्रि-काल, अम्, n. the three times, viz. past, present, and future time; morning, noon, and evening; the present, past, and future tenses of a verb; (अम्), ind. three times, thrice; (अस्, आ, अम्), connected with or relating to the three times (past, present, and future). —त्रिकाल-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the three times, omniscient; (अस्), m. a divine sage; a deity; a N. of Buddha, the founder of the Buddhist religion. —त्रिकाल-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, see-ing (or knowing) the past, present, and future, omni-scient; (ई), m. a Ṛṣi or divine sage; N. of Buddha. —त्रिकाल-विद्, त्, त्, त्, knowing the three times; (त्), m. a Buddha; (with Jainas) an Arhat. —त्रि-कुण्डी-श्वर (°ड-ईश्°?), अम्, n., N. of a Tantra. —त्रि-कूट, अस्, आ, अम्, having three peaks or humps or elevations &c.; (अस्), m., N. of several mountains, = त्रि-ककुद् and सु-वेल; a mountain in Ceylon on the top of which Laṅkā, the capital of Rāvaṇa, was situated; (अम्), n. sea-salt prepared by evapo-ration. —त्रिकूट-लवण, अम्, n. a peculiar kind of salt (= द्रोणी-लवण). —त्रिकूट-वत्, आन्, m., N. of a mountain. —त्रि-कूर्चक, अम्, n. a sort of knife with three edges. —त्रिकैक (°क-एक), Ved., N. of an Ekāha; [cf. एक-त्रिक।] —त्रि-कोण, अस्, आ, अम् (borrowed fr. the Gr. τρίγωνον), triangular, forming a triangle; (अस्, आ), m. f. Trapa Bispinosa; (अम्), n. (in astron.) N. of the fifth and ninth mansion [cf. त्रि-कोन-भवन and त्रि-त्रिकोण]; the vulva; [cf. त्रि-भुज्।] —त्रिकोण-कुण्ड, अम्, n., N. of a mystical vessel in the form of a diagram. —त्रिकोण-फल, अम्, n. Trapa Bispinosa. —त्रि-कोण-भवन, अम्, n. (in astron.) N. of the fifth and ninth mansion. —त्रि-क्रम, अस्, m. (according to the Prātiśākhyas) a Krama word composed of three words or members, the middle one of which is a single vowel. —त्रि-क्षार, अम्, n. the three burning or acrid substances, viz. natron, saltpetre, and borax. —त्रि-क्षुर, N. of a plant, = कोकिलाक्ष. —त्रि-ख, अम्, n. a cucumber (‘having three cavities’). —त्रि-खट्व, अम्, ई, n. f. three beds collectively. —त्रि-खण्ड, the earth as divided into three por-tions. —त्रि-खर्व, आस्, m. pl., Ved., N. of a particu-lar school of theologians. —त्रि-गङ्ग, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha; [cf. सप्त-गङ्ग।] —त्रि-गण, अस्, m. the aggregate of the three objects of existence, viz. virtue (धर्म), pleasure or the ‘dulce’ (काम), and wealth or the ‘utile’ (अर्थ); [cf. त्रि-वर्ग।] —त्रि-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, tripled; gone or done in three ways; (अम्), n. the expression of different senses by the same word. —त्रि-गन्धक, अम्, n. = त्रि-जातक, —त्रि-गम्भीर, see under गभीर. —त्रि-गर्त, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people inhabiting the modern Lahore; (अस्), m. a prince of the Tri-gartas; the country of the Tri-gartas; a particular method of calculation; (आ), f. a lascivious woman, a wanton; a woman in general; a kind of cricket (= घुर्-गुरी, घुर्गुरिका); a pearl. —त्रिगर्तक, आस्, m. pl. = त्रि-गर्त. —त्रिगर्त-राज, अस्, and त्रि-गर्त-राजन्, आ, m. king of Tri-garta. —त्रि-गर्-तिक, अस्, m. the country of the Tri-gartas. —त्रि-गुण, आस्, m. pl. the three qualities or constituents of nature and every existing thing, i. e. सत्-त्व, रजस्, and तमस्; (अस्, आ, अम्), consisting of three threads or strings; threefold, three times repeated, thrice, triple, treble (e. g. सप्त त्रिगुणानि दिनानि, three times seven days); containing the three Guṇas or properties; (अम्), ind. in three ways, three times, thrice. —त्रिगुणा-कर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, whose ears have two slits dividing them into three parts (as a mark of distinction). —त्रिगुणा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, thrice ploughed (a field &c.). —त्रि-ग्रामी, f. an assemblage of three villages, N. of a place. —त्रि-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, extending to the length of three (padyās). —त्रि-चक्षुस्, उस्, m. ‘triocular,’ ‘three-eyed,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (more properly of Śiva). —त्रि-चतुः-कर्ण, the third and fourth hypo-tenuses. —त्रि-चतुर, आस्, आस्, आणि, pl. three or four. —त्रि-चतुर्दश, औ, &c., du. the thir-teenth and fourteenth. —त्रिचत्वारिंश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the next), the forty-third. —त्रि-चत्वारिंशत्, त्, f. forty-three. —त्रि-चरित्र (?), अम्, n. three kinds of characters, (perhaps a wrong reading for स्त्री-चरित्र; cf. त्रि-गूढ।) —त्रि-चित्, त्, त्, त्, con-sisting of three layers or seats of sacrificial grass. —त्रि-चीवर, अम्, n. the three vestments of the Buddhist ascetic. —त्रिजगज्-जननी, f. the mother of the three worlds, an epithet of Pārvatī. —त्रि-जगत्, त्, n. or त्रि-जगती, f. the triple world, i. e. heaven, the intermediate region, and earth, or heaven, earth, and the lower world. —त्रिजगन्-मोहिनी, f. confound-ing the minds of the (inhabitants of the) three worlds, a form of Durgā (?). —त्रि-जट, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing three braids of hair; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; N. of a Brāhman; (आ), f., N. of a Rākṣasī who was friendly to Sītā; N. of a tree, = विल्व, Ægle Marmelos. —त्रिजटा-स्वप्न-दर्शन, अम्, n. ‘the dream of Tri-jaṭā,’ N. of a chapter in the fifth book of the Rāmāyaṇa. —त्रि-जात or त्रि-जातक, अम्, n. three spices collectively, viz. mace, cardamoms, and Laurus Cassia (cinnamon). —त्रि-जीवा, f. the sine of three signs or ninety degrees, a radius. —त्रि-ज्या, f. = the preceding. —त्रि-णत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. त्रि-नत), bent in three places, epithet of a bow;
